item.title: Iran vows revenge after the killing of its top leader and trades strikes with Israel in widening war
item.description: Iran has vowed revenge after the killing of its supreme leader.

item.title: Slauson and Crenshaw intersection officially named 'Nipsey Hussle Square'
item.description: Hundreds of fans gathered Saturday as the city named the intersection of Slauson and Crenshaw "Nipsey Hussle Square" to honor the late rapper's life and work in his South Los Angeles community.

item.title: Mother of 12-year-old details school fight in Reseda that left daughter dead
item.description: The mother said her daughter - Khimberly Zavaleta - was simply trying to protect her older sister from a group of bullies.

item.title: Catherine O'Hara wins posthumous Actor Award for 'The Studio'; Seth Rogan accepts on her behalf
item.description: A month after her unexpected death, Catherine O'Hara won a posthumous award at the 32nd Actor Awards for her performance on "The Studio." Seth Rogan accepted on her behalf, saying O'Hara "showed that you could be a genius and you could be kind."

item.title: Eyewitness Newsmakers: Inside LA's notorious prostitution hot spot, the Figueroa Corridor
item.description: ABC7 on Your Side Investigates Reporter Kevin Ozebek is giving more insight into what he experienced while spending time on "the Blade," and why the Figueroa Corridor is such an appealing location for human trafficking.

item.title: Oil prices rise sharply in market trading after attacks in Middle East disrupt global energy supply
item.description: Oil prices rose sharply when market trading began Sunday, as U.S. and Israeli attacks on Iran and retaliatory strikes against Israel and U.S. military installations around the Gulf sent disruptions through the global energy supply chain.

item.title: Large crowd rallies in Westwood, celebrating Khamenei's death and calling for Iranian freedom
item.description: A large crowd of demonstrators gathered on Sunday near the Federal Building in Westwood to call for freedom for the Iranian people in the wake of this weekend's U.S.-Israeli attack on Iran.

item.title: Flight cancellations at LAX grow as global air travel disrupted following strikes on Iran
item.description: Flights between LAX and major Middle Eastern hubs were canceled Sunday as disruptions spread worldwide following an attack on Iran.

item.title: Dramatic cooldown moves into Southern California on Monday
item.description: After a week defined by record-breaking heat, Southern California will experience a dramatic cooldown on Monday.

item.title: Destiny Littleton, a former USC women’s basketball player, describes fear amid Iranian retaliatory strikes in Israel
item.description: A Southern California native playing pro basketball in Israel is documenting her fear and uncertainty as Iranian retaliatory strikes continue.
